inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: In the pre-toddler 3 class, the teacher was out of ratio by two children when having 7 children with a specified age of 12-17 months.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection when a teacher came in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Based on the video footage, the infant teacher was seen placing a child in the rocker without being strapped in, and fastened that resulted in an injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Administrative and clerical duties that take caregiver's attention away from children: Based on the video footage, the infant teacher was seen with their back to the children while working on the classroom bulletin board.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administrative and clerical duties that take caregiver's attention away from children (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: The school-age children attending before school were being served cereal regularly instead of what was on the daily menu without substitutions being recorded.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions (26 TAC §746.3313(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation failed to contact Child Care Regulation on two separate incidents involving children being left unattended on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: There were two incidents involving children being left out on the playground unsupervised on separate occasions in which the parents were not properly notified.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: The Toddler I and Toddler III classroom each left a child on the playground during transition from outdoor play to the classroom. Both children were found by other staff at the operation and returned to their assign classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: The operation violated the probation conditions when they left two children unattended out on the playground, failed to notify their parents, failed to create the incident reports, and failed to contact Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: The operation did not create an incident report to share with the parents of two children that were left unsupervised on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Procedures: Two classrooms coming in from the playground did not wash the children's hands until they were told to do so by Child Care Regulation inspector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Procedures (26 TAC §746.3419)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: An infant classroom for ages 12-17 month old infants were having circle time using a tablet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: Information obtained during a routine investigation determined a child was observed walking in and out of the laundry room accompanied by two staff members.  This situation raises concerns on supervision and safety protocols.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: The incident report that was created for the child being left on the playground has not been shared with the parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: Operation failed to report a situation to parents where a two year old child was left unsupervised for one minute.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: An Incident report was not generated for an incident that involved a two year old child being left unsupervised on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for: Caregivers failed to conduct their routine name to face checks when transitioning their class from the playground to the classroom, which resulted in a 2 year old child being left unsupervised on the playground for one mintue.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that the director did not address a situation where a child was left unsupervised on the playground with all of the staff involved. The director also did not ensure a self-report was made to Child Care Regulation or that the parent were notified that their child was placed at risk
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A two year old child was left unsupervised for one minute.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Child Care Regulation was not notified of an incident where a two year old child was left unsupervised for one minute.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked: The complex knots created on the ribbon used as a locking mechanism prevents the gate that leads into an outdoor activity from being opened immediately in the event of an emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space -Gates Locked (26 TAC §746.4309)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The flexible baseboard was observed detached from the bottom of the wall causing the paint to chip off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: The operation was still not able to provide an incident report when asked by this inspector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver did not know how many children they were responsible for causing a four-year-old child to be left unsupervised for 49 seconds.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner: Two classrooms had trash container with soiled diapers without a trash lid making the contents accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3505(f))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: A signed incident report was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Paint was observed chipping of the wall  in one of the children's restrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children: It was determined that the caregiver forcefully picked up the child by the arm an sat the child down. The caregiver proceeded to put their face in the child's face and point a finger at the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(7))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: The lighting in the two year old classroom was not adequate.   Note: This was corrected at inspection as the director turned on the light located in classroom's restroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child's hands were not observed wash after a diaper change.     Note: This was corrected at inspection as the child's hands were washed during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside: The emergency evacuation and relocation did not have the designated location inside the operation were children and staff take shelter from threatening weather.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside (26 TAC §746.5207(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: The operation did not inform the parent at pick up that their child had sustained an injury while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))
